items.name: Spell Tower
items.description: For years, Wizards alone brought magic to the battlefield one fireball at a time. Now they've developed a fully automated way to give your village more ways to mess up attackers with magic!

items.name: Super Wizard Tower
items.description: Super Wizard's first strike can shock up to fifteen nearby enemies. Chained targets take less damage.

items.name: Wizard Tower
items.description: The Ultimate Arcane Defense! Tower Wizards cast powerful area effect spells that target both flying and ground troops.

items.name: X-Bow
items.description: The X-Bow shoots mystical bolts with terrifying power. Load it with Elixir and the X-Bow works automagically. You can set it to target ground units at long ranges, or all targets at reduced range.

items.name: Logger
items.description: A hardened meteorite hunk with a fascination for forestry. When Logger isn’t petting his mustache woodpeckers, he’s lobbing bouncing logs that push and crush all troop types. The timber may be slow, but it strikes with the full force of nature!

items.name: Longshot
items.description: Use your head! Longshot fires explosive bolts from her cranium at long range, peppering attackers with delightful dollops of splash damage.

items.name: Smasher
items.description: This tanky Guardian deals splash damage to ground and air troops. Smasher is a seriously sore loser, raging when the Town Hall is destroyed and leaving rage in his wake when defeated.

items.name: Action Figure
items.description: Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side
